newsitem.title: USA: Health Management sees $14-18 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Health Management sees $14-18 mln charge.

text.p: Health Management Inc said Tuesday it expects to report a charge of $14 million to $18 million in fiscal second quarter.
It said it settled all pending shareholder class action lawsuits filed against the company, resulting in the charge.

The litigation settlement, which is subject to final approval by the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York, includes the payment of $2 million in cash, the issuance of 2.2 million shares of HMI common stock and 2.2 million warrants to purchase common stock, the company said.
A portion of the cash payment is expected to be covered by the company's director's and officer's liability insurance carrier, HMI said.

The warrants will have a term of eight years from the date of issuance and will have an exercise price which is $.50 higher than the average closing price of HMI stock for a period specified in the settlement, it said.
"The company received preliminary approval from the court this morning and a hearing for final approval was set for November 8," said HMI chairman Andre Dimitriadis.
"If the court's subsequent final approval is granted at that hearing, which we are requesting, a distribution date next summer would be likely," he said.
Health Management Inc provides integrated pharmacy management services.
